name: 44055 · Lorain, OH
findings: ZIP 44055 (Lorain) has 42 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 18 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44055 (Lorain) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 44055 (Lorain) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 50% of the typical level).
